25c7badb-1c8c-4b96-a7dc-cb55f2ad86e4.title: Just Leave Me Be
25c7badb-1c8c-4b96-a7dc-cb55f2ad86e4.description:
Adele was a hapless orphan until a duke gave her a choice: live as a substitute for his dead daughter, or die on the streets. Despite playing this role to the best of her ability, an order for her assassination was given shortly after he married her off. Miraculously, she is sent back in time and decides to make up for the years wasted living a lie. As ancient ruins call to her, can she use her past knowledge and unexpected help from the Black Knight to defeat the dangers ahead and change fate?



---

**Links:**  
- [Promotional Video](https://youtu.be/klyrIC4ORo4)  
- [Official Indonesian Translation](https://kakaopage.co.id/content/Campakkan-Aku/3359)  
- [Official Japanese Translation](https://piccoma.com/web/product/33704)

f1522b1b-4b5a-4c09-bb39-8b092f4b7edd.title: Shoukan Sareta Kenja wa Isekai wo Yuku ~Saikyou na no wa Fuyou Zaiko no Aitemu deshita~
f1522b1b-4b5a-4c09-bb39-8b092f4b7edd.altTitle: Wise Man is Summoned to Another World: The Strongest Items were Those Less Desired in Inventory
f1522b1b-4b5a-4c09-bb39-8b092f4b7edd.description: Touya, the strongest player in the game Pandemic World Online, had won so many items that he decided to create an alternate account to store the extra ones. While playing this very game in his second account, he was summoned to another world as a character he made, where the people were merrily expecting a hero! However, when it's revealed that he doesn't have the title of a hero, he is discarded and replaced by another person. Now, he must survive in an another world with the account he merely used to store his extra items in.

6678b794-63fe-4f46-b94e-4bd55a21e594.title: The Lady's Butler
6678b794-63fe-4f46-b94e-4bd55a21e594.description: Harboring an obsession with the second male lead of the novel series *The Flower Holds a Sword*. Like always I write a commend about Lancelot and went to sleep. But something is off?! When I woke up my *favorite character* called me "milady" and brightly smiled at me! I think I won the lottery. Or I saved earth in my previous life. If you do good stuff in your past life you'll have good luck in your next life. If it's not that how could this even happen? This lottery that I won, I should use it properly. I decided I'll make my *favorite character*'s happiness my number one priority.

c26269c7-0f5d-4966-8cd5-b79acb86fb7a.title: Sewayaki Kitsune no Senko-san
c26269c7-0f5d-4966-8cd5-b79acb86fb7a.description:
Like many hardworking members of the workforce, Kuroto Nakano is perpetually stressed out by his job. Still, since he lives alone, he must carry on to sustain himself. Little do humans like Kuroto know, this stress takes the form of darkness residing within a person's body and will bring one's life to ruin.  
Fox deities can see this darkness and have the duty to save people before it is too late. To help rid Kuroto of his stress, Senko-san, an eight hundred-year-old foxgirl, volunteers to take care of him, and will do everything she can to ease the tension in his weary soul.

---

**Notes:**
- Despite initial serialization ending by November 2022, Comic Newtype announced on 9 February 2023 that the series would later resume publication.

a5195524-999d-491c-9304-2a8fe2440e50.title: Good Doctor
a5195524-999d-491c-9304-2a8fe2440e50.description:
The main character, Park Si-on, suffers from autism and savant syndrome.
With his innate genius like two sides of the same coin, he enters a pediatric surgery resident at a university hospital.
The prejudice of being a doctor with autism and the battle for power in the hospital are getting more and more dangerous...!
Will I ever be able to become a real doctor?

---

- Based on 2013 K-drama of the same name

e4351665-25f3-4edd-8546-10e5122e721d.title: Tsumi to Batsu no Spica
e4351665-25f3-4edd-8546-10e5122e721d.description: Hatori, a high school teacher leading an ordinary life, notices one day that his student, Spica Tsumugi, is being bullied. On a rainy day after school, Hatori finds himself alone with Tsumugi by chance. Hatori tells her, "I'll do something about it!" but Tsumugi gently takes his hand and says with a smile, "Hatori-sensei, you're such a liar." Teacher and student... two people who should not get too close. This somewhat bewitching girl will dramatically change Hatori's ordinary life.

94d0b667-1076-4438-ba9d-700c42f06bef.title: Ashita mo Ii Hi de Arimasu you ni
94d0b667-1076-4438-ba9d-700c42f06bef.altTitle: May Tomorrow Be Another Good Day: A New Family Was Born in Another World—Three Brothers' Heartwarming Food Diary
94d0b667-1076-4438-ba9d-700c42f06bef.description:
The three brothers Yuito, Haruto, and Yuuma lost their mother in a traffic accident and were taken in by their father, who lived apart from them, spending their days enduring unreasonable violence. Just when they were on the verge of despair, given no proper meals and having no relatives to rely on—they were caught in a landslide and all three were reincarnated together into an Isekai. A passing adventurer, Thomas, protected the three who had collapsed by the roadside, and together with his wife Olivia, who runs the eatery "Olive Tree," they welcomed the three as a "New Family"... The warm Isekai Slow Life spun by the beloved three brothers begins!
___
[Original Web Novel](https://ncode.syosetu.com/n3479gg)

2cea9657-a68b-4d21-a3f4-6b74e93082e5.title: School of Street
2cea9657-a68b-4d21-a3f4-6b74e93082e5.description: Hyeun is a genius dancer but has stage fright, and Suhyun is a beginner dancer but is not afraid of the stage. This is the Street Dance growth story of two different dancers!

82cea62c-e413-4f60-91c7-f1d0171c2806.title: Burning Hell
82cea62c-e413-4f60-91c7-f1d0171c2806.description: The story unfolds on the island of Burning Hell, located near Dokdo, involving two murderers. Criminals and monsters from Joseon, Edo, Qing, and the British Empire come to this island, each harboring their own desires.

8962eeeb-42c7-49fd-8340-83a03cbf4950.title: Single Dad In Another World
8962eeeb-42c7-49fd-8340-83a03cbf4950.description: One day, my wife disappeared. My young daughter suffers from a rare disease with no cure, and life offers no chance to breathe. Just when I was about to give up on everything— I suddenly found myself transported to another world with my daughter. And not just any world… but the dark, terrifying fantasy novel my wife wrote! I have to save my daughter, no matter what.

18f7c6e0-709b-4991-90bb-85eec9fa9663.title: Hole up Gamers
18f7c6e0-709b-4991-90bb-85eec9fa9663.description:
In the near future, the full-dive VR game Visions has taken Japan by storm. However, a flaw in the game leads to a series of fatal accidents involving players who remain logged in for extended periods. 

To halt the game, an attempt is made to force all players to log out, but a group of players rebels and barricades themselves within the game world. To evict these players and bring them back to reality, Shin Hato — a protagonist belonging to the Regional Welfare Department’s Hikikomori Support Office — ventures into the world of Visions to make contact, but...?

b419fea0-e40c-469f-9aec-d3a02c58b2fa.title: Akairo Crossroads
b419fea0-e40c-469f-9aec-d3a02c58b2fa.description:
Is being unable to see the red string of fate better?!  
Since the encounter on the day of the high school entrance ceremony, dog-like boy, Makita Keita and cat-like girl, Ohara Tamaki have had the worst relationship.  
The story starts to progress when the both of them are put in the same class.  
A little mysterious heart racing school youth graffiti begins!

chapters.title: Love You Want to Look After
Like Two Peas in a Pod

3e3604cc-97b5-43f0-ab2c-c144debcae87.title: Yu☆Gi☆Oh! OCG STORIES
3e3604cc-97b5-43f0-ab2c-c144debcae87.description:
In the distant past, the prosperous nation of Karma waged war against the nation of Spectra, resulting in the creation of an AI that wiped out all humans. Centuries later, Raye, the last surviving human, lives amongst an android society on the outskirts of Karma. On the night of her 13th birthday, her peaceful life is upended when Spectra attacks, destroying her home and forcing her friends to the front lines. Desperate to save everything she loves, Raye calls upon humanity's last bastion: "Sky Striker", the Karma-developed secret technology made to turn humans into the ultimate living weapons.… Unexpected, right? In this newest adaptation of Yu-Gi-Oh, the focus of the plot is not on the card game, but instead the many storylines featured in the cards. The first arc surrounds the Sky Striker series, with more to come in the future.

Sky Striker: Ch 1-19
Magistus: Ch 20-33
Magical War: Ch 34-?

e0413c01-9d2b-40ca-8368-4287aa9b5fff.title: Madara Moyou no Yoi
e0413c01-9d2b-40ca-8368-4287aa9b5fff.description:
After running away from home, Yoi has nowhere to go because she looks different from other people. In her time of need, who reaches out to her...?

This girl who doesn't fit in (in more ways than one) has to survive in a world of despair with her own existence on the line!
